test_pybind11_class_repr: test that repr of pybind11 bound types includes pybind11_type and class name
test_pybind11_class_inheritance: test pybind11 class inheritance with Pet, Dog, Rabbit, and Hamster bound types
test_pybind11_class_docstrings: test that pybind11 bound methods and properties have correct generated docstrings
test_pybind11_class_qualname: test that nested pybind11 classes have correct __qualname__ and module attributes
test_pybind11_class_upcasting: test automatic upcasting of derived classes returned from pybind11 bound functions
